bicentenaria:enwiki:4.title: Bicentenaria (General construction, size and distinctive features)

facts.statement: Bicentenaria lived during the Early Cretaceous (Albian) period in the Candeleros Formation of Argentina.
facts.quote: Bicentenaria (meaning "two hundred year anniversary"; named after the 200th anniversary of the 1810 May Revolution in Argentina) is an extinct genus of carnivorous coelurosaurian theropods which lived during the Early Cretaceous (Albian) Candeleros Formation of Argentina.

facts.statement: Bones and claws of Bicentenaria were discovered in 1998 by Rauel Spedale and friends after a drop in water levels at the Ezequiel Ramos Mexía Reservoir exposed fossils.
facts.quote: In 1998, after a drop in the water level at the Ezequiel Ramos Mexía Reservoir had exposed rocks from the Candeleros Formation, Rauel Spedale and his two friends went on a fishing trip and discovered several bones and claws sticking out of the ground, which were several specimens of Bicentenaria, including the holotype.

facts.statement: The discoverer, Rauel Spedale, initially believed the fossils belonged to a machairodontine cat.
facts.quote: Spedale excavated the fossils using a pocket knife along with his bare hands, and he believed that he had discovered the remains of a machairodontine.

facts.statement: The species Bicentenaria argentina was formally described and published by Novas et al. in August 2012.
facts.quote: The fossils were determined to have belonged to a new genus of dinosaur, and the name Bicentenaria argentina was first reported in news articles in June 2012, and the paper describing it was formally published in August 2012 by Novas et al. (2012).

facts.statement: The holotype specimen MPCA 865 consists of the back of a skull attached to the back of the lower jaws.
facts.quote: The holotype, MPCA 865, consists of the back of a skull and attached to it the back of the lower jaws.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria was a small bipedal predator with an estimated body length of 2.5 to 3 meters.
facts.quote: Bicentenaria is a rather small bipedal predatory saurian whose body length is estimated at 2.5 to 3 m in length.

facts.statement: The anterior upper jaw teeth of Bicentenaria have serrations only at the base of the tooth crown.
facts.quote: The praemaxillary teeth of the anterior upper jaw have only serrations at the base of the tooth crown.

facts.statement: The hand claws on the outer fingers of Bicentenaria have posteriorly overhanging edges on their tops.
facts.quote: The hand claws of the outer fingers have posteriorly overhanging leg edges on their posterior top.

facts.statement: The praemaxilla of Bicentenaria bears at least four teeth with a circular cross-section.
facts.quote: The praemaxilla bears at least four teeth that have a circular cross-section.

facts.statement: Most teeth of Bicentenaria lack serrations, except for one tooth that has serrations on the upper half of its anterior margin.
facts.quote: Most teeth have no serrations but a second right tooth has serrations on the upper half of the anterior margin.

facts.statement: The quadratum bone is robust, lacks pneumatization, and has a small, high-placed foramen quadraticum.
facts.quote: The quadratum is robust, without pneumatization and with a small and high-placed foramen quadraticum.

facts.statement: The angular bone of the lower jaw has a distinctive elliptical hollow on its underside.
facts.quote: The angular has a distinctive elliptical hollow on the underside.

facts.statement: The articular bone is robust, lacks pneumatization, and features a large retroarticular protrusion shaped like a spoon and angled upwards.
facts.quote: The articular is robust, without pneumatization. It has a robust large retroarticular protrusion, the posterior tip of the bottom that is shaped like a spoon and angled upwards.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria was described by Novas et al. in 2012.
facts.quote: parent_authority: Novas et al., 2012

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Bicentenaria is B. argentina.
facts.quote: It contains the type species, B. argentina.

facts.statement: The longest known sacrum of Bicentenaria consists of four fused vertebrae, though researchers believe the total count was likely five.
facts.quote: The longest sacrum found consists of a series of four fused vertebrae; The describers assumed that the total number of sacral vertebrae was in fact five.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence shows that Bicentenaria possessed claws that were strongly curved and flattened transversely.
facts.quote: From the hand, claws have been found that are quite strongly curved and flattened transversely.

facts.statement: Some of Bicentenaria's claws have lips and lumps on their posterior edges that served as attachment points for stretching and flexing muscles.
facts.quote: Some claws have lips and lumps on both the upper and lower posterior edges as attachment for the stretching and flexing muscles.

facts.statement: Researchers consider the occurrence of upper leg lips in Bicentenaria a unique derived trait (autapomorphy) because it is rare among coelurosaurs.
facts.quote: The upper leg lips occur in both very basal and highly derived coelurosaurs; since this occurrence is not common, the descriptors assumed that the trait could count as an autapomorphy, unique derived property, of Bicentenaria.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria had a well-developed leg apron between its pubic shafts that began as a sharp ledge at the top of the shaft.
facts.quote: Between the lower pubic shafts is a well-developed leg apron that begins at the top of the shaft as a sharp ledge.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria is estimated to have measured between 2.5 and 3 meters in length and weighed approximately 40 kilograms.
facts.quote: Se estima que llegó a medir entre 2,5 a 3 metros y a pesar unos 40 kilos.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria's quadratojugal bone has a frontal branch that is twice as long as its ascending branch.
facts.quote: El cuadradoyugal tiene una rama frontal que es el doble de larga que la rama ascendente.

facts.statement: The only known maxillary tooth of Bicentenaria is very flattened and features striations on both the cutting and exiting edges extending to the tip.
facts.quote: El único diente maxilar conocido es muy aplanado y tiene estrías en tanto el borde de ataque y el borde de salida que se extiende todo el camino hasta el extremo.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria's quadratojugal has a thin anterior branch that greatly exceeds the length of the ascending branch, whereas in most related dinosaurs this branch is simply short.
facts.quote: El cuadradoyugal tiene una rama anterior delgada que excede en gran medida de la longitud de la rama ascendente, en la mayoría de los dinosaurios relacionados es que simplemente corto.

facts.statement: Bicentenaria's articular bone is robust, non-pneumatized, and features a large solid retroarticular process shaped like a spoon that points obliquely upward.
facts.quote: El articular es robusta, sin neumatizar. Tiene una gran protuberancia sólida retroarticular, el punto posterior de la parte inferior que tiene la forma de una cuchara y se dirige oblicuamente hacia arriba.

facts.statement: Because multiple specimens, including a juvenile, were found together, researchers concluded that Bicentenaria lived in groups.
facts.quote: Debido a que se encontraron varios ejemplares juntos, inclusive un juvenil los autores han llegado a la conclusión de que Bicentenaria vivía en grupos.

facts.statement: Novas et al. (2012) classified Bicentenaria within Coelurosauria, determining it to be less basal than Tugulusaurus.
facts.quote: Novas et al. (2012) classified Bicentenaria within Coelurosauria, and was found to be less basal than Tugulusaurus.

facts.statement: The genus Bicentenaria was described by Novas et al. in 2012.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Novas et al., 2012

facts.statement: Bicentenaria lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Cretácico Superior

facts.statement: Bicentenaria lived approximately 90 million years ago during the Turonian stage of the Late Cretaceous in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 90 millones de años, en el Turoniense, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica.

facts.statement: The fossil was discovered in 1998 near Lago Ramos Mejía in Río Negro Province, Argentina, by Raúl Spedale, a concrete company employee who was fishing.
facts.quote: Fue hallado en 1998 a orillas del Lago Ramos Mejía en la Formación Candeleros, en la Provincia de Río Negro, Patagonia, Argentina, por Raúl Spedale, un empleado de una hormigonera que fue a pescar al mismo.

facts.statement: Between 1999 and 2000, Spedale used a hammer and chisel to remove a thirty to forty centimeter surface layer at a depth of half a meter to expose more bones.
facts.quote: En 1999 y 2000 retiró una superficie de sólo treinta a cuarenta centímetros con martillo y cincel a una profundidad de medio metro más huesos expuestos, que expuso en mostrar en su casa.

facts.statement: Further excavation became impossible after the water level in the lake rose again.
facts.quote: Posteriormente, al subir de nuevo el agua hizo que más excavaciones sean imposible.

facts.statement: A local school teacher recognized the uniqueness of the find and contacted paleontologist Raúl Ortiz.
facts.quote: Un maestro de una escuela local que después de ver el descubrimiento Spedale entiende que es algo único y se pone en contacto con el paleontólogo Raúl Ortiz.

facts.statement: The name was first published in press articles in June 2012 and formally described in an article in August 2012.
facts.quote: El nombre apareció primero en artículos de prensa en junio de 2012, y fue posteriormente publicado formalmente en un artículo en agosto de 2012.

facts.statement: The species Bicentenaria argentina was named and described in 2012 by Ortiz, Novas, Ezcurra, Agnolín, and Pol.
facts.quote: En 2012 fue la especie tipo Bicentenaria argentina nombrada y descrita por Ortiz, Fernando Novas, Martín Ezcurra , Federico Agnolín y Diego Pol.

facts.statement: The generic name honors the 200th anniversary of Argentina's independence and the Museo Argentino de Ciencias Naturales.
facts.quote: Se le colocó el nombre genérico en honor a los 200 años de la independencia de Argentina y del Museo Argentino de Ciencias Naturales.

facts.statement: The specific name refers solely to Argentina.
facts.quote: El nombre específico se refiere solo a Argentina.

facts.statement: The fossils were found in Candeleros Formation layers dating to the Cenomanian, approximately 95 million years ago.
facts.quote: Los fósiles fueron encontrados en las capas de la formación Candeleros que datan del Cenomaniano, aproximadamente hace 95 millones de años.

facts.statement: The recovered remains represent at least three adult and one juvenile specimen, including the holotype MPCA 865, which consists of the posterior half of a skull with an articulated mandible.
facts.quote: Los restos recuperados representan, al menos, tres ejemplares adultos y alguno joven, entre ellos el holotipo (MPCA 865), la mitad caudal de un cráneo con la mandíbula articulada.

facts.statement: The paratype MPCA 866 is a collection of loose bones from at least four individuals, including parts of a postcranium.
facts.quote: El paratipo , MPCA 866, es una colección de huesos sueltos de al menos cuatro individuos, incluyendo partes de un postcráneo.

facts.statement: The paratype includes two premaxilla fragments with three tooth pairs, a right upper jaw fragment with a tooth, seventeen vertebrae, fourteen sacral vertebrae, twenty tail vertebrae, shoulder blade pieces, a coracoid fragment, a radius fragment, eight hand claws, an ilium piece, five pubis shafts, five partial femurs, two left tibia upper parts, a right tibia lower part, an ankle bone piece, five metatarsal pieces, fifteen toe phalanges, and claw pieces.
facts.quote: Incluye, dos fragmentos de premaxilares con tres pares de dientes, un pedazo de la rama de la mandíbula superior derecha con un diente, diecisiete piezas de vértebras, catorce vértebras sacras, veinte vértebras caudales, piezas de dos omóplatos, una esquina posterior superior de un coracoides, el final de un radio, ocho garras de mano.; piezas de un hueso ilíaco izquierdo, cinco ejes superior del pubis, cinco fémures parciales, las partes superiores de dos tibia izquierda, la parte inferior de una tibia derecha, un hueso derecho del tobillo, piezas de cinco metatarsianos, Quince falanges de ocho pies y las piezas de las garras.

facts.statement: In total, one hundred thirty bones were recovered besides the skull bones, representing at least three adults and several juveniles.
facts.quote: En total, además de los huesos del cráneo se rescataron ciento treinta huesos y que representen al menos tres adultos y varios juveniles.

facts.statement: The bones are in good condition with intact surfaces showing no erosion or bite marks from scavengers.
facts.quote: Los huesos están en buenas condiciones, con una superficie ósea intacta que no ha erosionado o marcas de mordeduras que muestran carroñeros.

facts.statement: The museum has prepared two skeleton models.
facts.quote: El museo ha preparado dos modelos de esqueleto.

facts.statement: The describers placed Bicentenaria in a very basal position within Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: Bicentenaria fue colocado por sus descriptores en una posición muy basal en Coelurosauria.

facts.statement: According to a cladistic analysis, it is phylogenetically close to Tugulusaurus but just below the Tyrannosauroidea, which are in turn more basal than Compsognathidae.
facts.quote: De acuerdo con un análisis cladístico es próximo filogenéticamente a Tugulusaurus, pero justo por debajo de los Tyrannosauroidea que a su vez resultan más basales que Compsognathidae.

facts.statement: It is likely the first representative of a new basal Coelurosauria lineage, phylogenetically close to Tugulusaurus.
facts.quote: Es probable que sea el primer representante de un nuevo linaje basal de Coelurosauria, próximo filogenéticamente a Tugulusaurus.

facts.statement: The time range for the genus is the Albian stage, from 113.2 to 110.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (113.2 to 110.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group for Bicentenaria is Coelurosauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Coelurosauria

facts.statement: Bicentenaria is classified in the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia
